verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says it onboards new hires and offers employee self-service in one system, and new-hire HR data flows automatically into Payroll. Nothing in the pack shows a self-serve flow sent to the hire that collects W-4, I-9 or bank details before the start date. missing for 10: documented collection of W-4 tax withholding forms, I-9 employment verification, bank/direct-deposit details, a pre-start-date self-serve invite flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: Onboard new hires, run payroll, manage performance, and issue devices and corporate cards instantly and without switching systems.
Having everything in one system for [all] three countries—including benefits, employee-self-service, and onboarding—just made sense.
With Rippling, HR data—like new hires, salary changes, and benefits deductions—flow directly and automatically into Payroll.
